data.name: Nerobreak: Cult Fall
data.detailed_description:
In 1983, in the city the influence of the criminal gang "Cipher" is growing. They are involved in the distribution of illegal substances, expanding their reach. Unconfirmed rumors suggest the gang is involved in a mass disappearance of people. However, this is attributed to the appearance of a serial killer in the city...

A neo-noir adventure game inspired by the films of Argento, Refn, and French cinema. The project is a first-person action game with light quest elements, visual novel elements, and hints of cyberpunk and neo-noir.

You will play as Leon, a member of a local criminal group, and Mylène Renault, a police officer. One is a criminal, the other a law enforcement officer, but this is not a love story; it is a gritty, psychological thriller, bordering on the insane at times. The story takes place over the course of one month, but it is not presented chronologically, so to understand the entire plot, you will have to be very attentive or play through the game several times.

Features:

An atmospheric action-adventure game in the style of retro games from the late 90s, combining elements of a shooter and a visual novel;

A cyberpunk, neo-noir plot with multiple characters.

Completion time: 3 hours, which is about the same as watching a full-length film or several episodes of a TV series in one evening.

data.short_description: A neo-noir adventure set in October 1983, as the influence of the criminal gang "Cipher" grows in the city. They are involved in the distribution of illegal substances and causing mass disappearances. A plot-driven retro action film with elements of quest, novella, cyberpunk, and neo-noir
